spanish: Y sumergirá el sacerdote su dedo desde la sangre, y rociará siete veces delante de Jehová, ante faces del velo.

findings.issue: delante de smooths the plural construct noun faces inside the compound preposition into a bare preposition; the before-relation remains

notes: Priest, finger, from the blood, seven times, Jehová, and ante faces del velo match the tokens.
